steps.en: Install the skill into your coding agent
steps.zh: 把技能安装到编程助手

steps.en: Request a page with its audience, intended action and tone
steps.zh: 提出页面需求，说明受众、预期操作和语气

steps.en: Inspect existing design rules and ask the context question
steps.zh: 检查现有设计规则，提出上下文问题

steps.en: Confirm the context or delegate the remaining choices
steps.zh: 确认上下文，或授权助手选择剩余项

steps.en: Choose structure and theme, then guide code generation and self-critique
steps.zh: 选择结构和主题，指导代码生成与自评

steps.en: Inspect the rendered page and approve the result
steps.zh: 检查渲染后的页面，确认结果

value.en: Get a deliberate page design rather than another default hero-and-card template
value.zh: 得到有意选择的页面设计，而非又一个默认首屏卡片模板
